$comment: Human rulings the generator cannot derive. Keyed by NAS source folder.
primaryXodr: which XODR of a multi-XODR folder is the source (default: the one matching the GLB).
world: force the cooked world instead of the geoReference/extent match.
acceptDecisionItems: exact decisionRequired strings a human accepted; any new item re-opens the decision.
hold: keep an otherwise bindable source unbound, with the reason.
Every entry must say who decided and when (decidedBy, date).
